# Routes

Every file in `src/app/` is a route (Expo Router). Layouts (`_layout.tsx`) define the navigators and the `Stack.Protected` role guards. Groups in parentheses, such as `(tabs)`, do not appear in the URL. See [the frontend guide](../handbook/03-frontend.md) for how routing and guards work.
